source.mutability: The official documentation URLs are mutable. Generation fails closed unless the index, overview, root reference, and aggregate hash of all 320 endpoint pages match this reviewed corpus.

exclusions.title: Create an upload resource
exclusions.reason: The official CMA route requires an application/octet-stream binary file body. The current REST binding can preserve JSON or UTF-8 body_raw but cannot encode arbitrary binary bytes without corruption.

auth.selected: Bearer token supplied only by the enrolled contentful connection

source_decision.reason: The endpoint corpus proves callable CMA routes but this run has no owner connection or stored live response capture proving a stable owner task or note surface. No work-entity Source is claimed from documentation alone.

authority_notes.eu_origin_not_claimed: The current contentful connection requirement is pinned to api.contentful.com; the separately documented api.eu.contentful.com residency origin requires a distinct connection contract.
authority_notes.compatibility_route_alias: entry.create_with_id and entry.update intentionally preserve distinct argument contracts over the same official PUT route.
